description: Immutable RoadSense Gate D v3 remote command; session-gateway edge verification and unchanged approved data pair.

ReleaseJsonBase64.description: Base64-encoded exact Gate D release JSON

runCommand:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
script="$(mktemp /tmp/roadsense-gate-d.XXXXXX.sh)"
clean_home="$(mktemp -d /tmp/roadsense-gate-d-home.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$script"; rm -rf "$clean_home"' EXIT
[[ -n "${AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE:-}" && -r "$AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE" ]]
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$script"
printf '%s  %s\n' 'e2defbadd032e539c81ae24939eaef70a9f792cbf542fe08e815240af9a86031' "$script" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null
aws_env=(env -u AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID -u AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY -u AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
  -u AWS_SECURITY_TOKEN -u AWS_PROFILE -u AWS_ROLE_ARN
  -u AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE -u AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI
  -u AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_FULL_URI
  AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE="$AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE" AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null
  AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true HOME="$clean_home")
test "$("${aws_env[@]}" aws sts get-caller-identity --query Arn --output text)" = \
  'arn:aws:sts::918870682888:assumed-role/SynergieSSMHybridManagedInstanceCore/mi-0dade13fd68d1b435'
"${aws_env[@]}" RELEASE_JSON_B64="$SSM_ReleaseJsonBase64" bash "$script"
